Fixed the mission numbering and crashes that might happen after missions.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 - Pathfinding and mission fixes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.8 has bugfixes and a main menu, with some things meant to lead up to the addition of endless mode.

[list]
[*] A new save button at the management menu
[*] A new main menu
[*] Fixes to unit pathfinding preventing movement in some cases
[*] The flamethrower ammo cost is now cheaper
[*] the AN-47 ammo cost is now cheaper
[*] Fixes to a bug that resets mission progress if you play a previous mission
[*] Quit now returns to main menu
[/list]

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Post-launch plans
notes.notes:
[h1]Moving forward - v1.1 and v1.2 plans[/h1]

With the release of the game, I want to tell you about the next plans:

[h2]v1.1[/h2]
v1.1 will come a week or two after release, and center around adding Endless Mode. In this mode, it's more of a roguelike challenge of surviving as long as you can, without story. Also adding polish, fixing bugs, and improving many of the animations and balance issues the game may have.

Of course, these are fixes I can afford to do slowly. If there are game-breaking issues, those will be addressed immediately

[h2]v1.2[/h2]
This one will have to depend on interest, but will include major changes:

[list]
[*]Resizing of tiles to make the game look less cramped
[*]The necessary changes to stats due to new tile sizes
[*]Ability to pan camera
[*]Mobile version! That will probably not be on Steam, though.
[/list]
